answer: An agent market for reef surveys and nectar yield forecasts requires each trading identity to lock 100 tokens in a vault for 30 days before submitting one bid per auction. Creating more names grants no extra bids without more deposits: 1,000 bidding identities require 100,000 locked tokens. The mechanism makes influence scale with committed capital, so a sybil attacker pays the opportunity cost of immobilizing funds for every added bid.
